scope: Raw original sensor/launcher/relay data for tutorial handoff and later kill objectives

placements.name: SENSOR2.BSP
placements.script_text:
collision off
render off

define repeats 1
define sensor_range 0
define broadcast_range 120
define broadcast_message 0
define activate_msg 1001

waitfor 1 activate_msg
  sensor repeats sensor_range broadcast_range broadcast_message
end

placements.name: LAUNCH2.BSP
placements.script_text:
render off
collision off

;When receiving STARTKEY, this script will launch STARTAMOUNT cars of
;the specified type. Whenever one of them is killed, it broadcasts DEATHKEY

;This is useful for mission goals, so you can keep track of when a
;number of them has been hit

define StartKey 1100
define StartAmount 1
define DeathKey 1103
define type 0
define bounty 0
define speed 0

waitfor 1 StartKey
  launch StartAmount type bounty speed DeathKey
end

placements.name: RELAY.BSP
placements.script_text:
render off
collision off

define trigger 9999
define relay1 0
define relay2 0
define relay3 0
define relay4 0
define relay5 0
define relay6 0
define delay 1
waitfor 1 trigger
  timer2 1 delay delay
    broadcast 0 relay1
    broadcast 0 relay2
    broadcast 0 relay3
    broadcast 0 relay4
    broadcast 0 relay5
    broadcast 0 relay6
  end
end
